title: Require owner in validateApp (shared-contracts) and pass team from each app's package.json

summary: validateApp in libs/shared-contracts now throws if app.owner is missing; core-shell (platform), billing (payments), reports (insights) pass owner matching the team in their package.json. Assumptions: libs/shared-contracts lives in the monorepo and is inlined at build, so platformkit needed no change or release; team values hardcoded because the inlining build can't import package.json. PR #1 merged, CI and CD green.
